_comment: Topside: surface buildings (rooms with "topside": true on floor -1 in rooms.json) and weather. Typed in src/sim/systems/weather.ts; see docs/design/M7-spec.md. weather.kinds[k].production is the default multiplier for topside rooms; buildings[type][kind] overrides it per building. Penalties (multipliers below 1) shrink by the weatherproofing bonus; topsideOutput adds on top. Storm taint is per minute for anyone in a topside room, online only, cut by stormShielding plus the best staffed watchtower's shelter share, and never pushes taint past storm.taintCap x max HP. Watchtowers: each staffed tower gives its level's share, scaled by crew Sight / sightForFull (at most 1); shares from several towers add up to the caps.

clear.name: Clear skies
clear.description: Sunshine, a light breeze and a Glare index of 'mild'. Halcyon Meteorology recommends a picnic, at your own risk.

dust.name: Dust storm
dust.description: A wall of grit off the Glarelands. Solar panels sulk, crops choke, and the turbines have the time of their lives.

taintstorm.name: Taint storm
taintstorm.description: Green rain and a sky that hums. Anyone working topside soaks up Glare. Please remember your complimentary poncho.

heatwave.name: Heatwave
heatwave.description: The sun has been promoted. Solar output soars; everything wet or green would like a word with management.

achievements.name: Room With a View
achievements.description: Build your first surface building. Mind the sky.

achievements.name: Small Talk
achievements.description: See the weather change 25 times. Lovely weather we're having, whatever it is.

achievements.name: Umbrella Policy

achievements.name: Hardy Perennials
achievements.description: Topside workers absorb 100 Glare from taint storms. Halcyon thanks them for their service.

achievements.name: Fair-Weather Friend
